title: Quasi-compact empty base change is eventually empty
statement: Let $I$ be directed, let $(S_i)$ be an inverse system of schemes with affine transition maps and limit $S$, and fix $i$. If $T\to S_i$ is quasi-compact and $T\times_{S_i}S$ is empty, then $T\times_{S_i}S_{i'}$ is empty for every sufficiently large $i'\ge i$.

source.place: Limits, Lemma 32.4.9 (label lemma-limit-eventually-empty), Tag 05F3, using Lemmas 32.2.3 and 32.4.3; statement extracted from source.

mathlib_searches.query: quasi-compact scheme T with empty base change to an inverse limit has empty base change at a sufficiently large finite stage
mathlib_searches.results: No theorem for eventual emptiness of scheme base changes; only generic limit and compactness results

mathlib_searches.query: eventual emptiness after base change along inverse system of schemes

mathlib_searches.results: No declaration of Stacks 05F3; AffineTransitionLimit.lean contains limit constructions but not this eventual-emptiness lemma
